Japanese Police.text: The prefectural police forces under the National Police Agency: patrol officers, detectives, traffic and riot units, custody officers and prisoner transport. They investigate crimes, secure scenes, take statements and make arrests, but officers do not use their Quirks as weapons, so they rely on licensed heroes to stop villains in a fight. A typical incident ends with a hero restraining someone and an officer snapping on the handcuffs. Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi is a familiar face around Musutafu. Most people trust the police and barely notice them. The visible contradiction: officers hold the legal power to arrest, question and detain, yet heroes get the headlines, the rankings and the credit.
